title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
slides: New York's AI safety law is live — will OpenAI comply?
It mandates disclosure of safety testing before deployment
But the law's enforcement budget is surprisingly thin
Your AI vendor contracts may now need safety clauses
Check today if your provider publishes compliance reports
thread_text:
1. NY's AI Safety Law Is Live

Companies deploying AI in New York must now disclose safety testing before launch. The law has teeth — but will OpenAI comply?

2. Enforcement Budget Is Thin

Despite ambitious mandates, the budget for oversight is surprisingly small. Who's actually checking the disclosures?

3. Your Contracts Need Safety Clauses

If your AI vendor isn't compliant, you could be liable. Update your contracts to require safety testing proof.

4. Compliance Reports: Ask Now

Your provider should publish compliance reports. If they don't, you're in the dark about their safety practices.

5. Check Your Vendor Today

Ask your AI provider for their latest compliance report. If they can't produce one, it's time to reconsider the partnership.
